_about: Round 3 list (Amazon US, researched 2026-10-30, for review): every instrument taught at the Academy (violin, guitar, piano, percussion, winds, oriental) with more brands, sizes and colours, plus the sub-categories still empty (electronic drums, podcast kits, keyboard & acoustic amps, DJ mixers) and a few art, studio, vinyl and book additions. Same rules as round 2: in stock (no "only 1–3 left"), nothing that can't be flown (no lithium batteries), products already in the shop left out, heavy and few-review items kept. kg = boxed shipping weight (Amazon's, or an estimate). our_price = round_up((amazon_price + kg × 20) × 1.3) − 0.01; "price at import" = Amazon hides the price from Lebanon (big brands), Spreadr fills it in. Products sold with a choice carry merge_variants (option B: every value is imported, then merged with merge-variants.mjs). Not the whole $10 budget: the Amazon UAE round comes next.
